title: Preschool Registration Checklist
subtitle: Capture class placement, start readiness, daily routine, and support route; confirm authorized pickup and family orientation.
description: Preschool Registration records class placement, start readiness, daily routine, support route, authorized pickup, and family orientation. Preschool Registration evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this preschool registration stage-gated verification when staff must document class placement and start readiness. Reconcile daily routine, support route, authorized pickup, and family orientation before the preschool registration handoff. Use the application, age or placement source, classroom availability, readiness list, daily-routine sheet, pickup authorization, orientation receipt, and start confirmation. Ask the assigned preschool registration reviewer to confirm class placement against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Preschool Registration starting details review
sections.guidance: Confirm class and start readiness, daily routine, meal and rest information, support route, pickup list, orientation, and classroom transition.

sections.title: Preschool Registration exception review: checks and corrections
sections.guidance: Check current preschool registration facts at point of use.

blocks.label: Preschool Registration required checks
items: Class placement is identified for this record
Start readiness matches the current request or source
Daily routine is ready for point-of-use staff
Support route limits or questions are resolved
Authorized pickup is communicated to the responsible person
Family orientation is confirmed at handoff
A changed preschool registration fact is returned for review

blocks.label: Preschool Registration failed or pending items

sections.title: Preschool Registration readiness
sections.guidance: Hold preschool registration readiness on any failed or pending item.

blocks.label: Preschool Registration reviewer receipt

fields.label: Responsible teacher or program coordinator and date

blocks.guidance: Preschool Registration receipt confirms the visible checklist result.
